categories.main_business_segments: BGT Group focuses on industrial water treatment, high-salinity wastewater resource recovery, and comprehensive development of salt lakes and mineral resources. Its business is divided into water treatment solutions, operation management and technical services, and product manufacturing and sales. The company serves industries including coal chemical, petrochemical, coking, bio-chemical, electronics semiconductor, heavy metal wastewater, salt lake lithium extraction, seawater desalination, and industrial parks.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company relies on proprietary technologies such as high-salinity wastewater zero discharge salt separation, efficient reclaimed water reuse processes, high-salinity complex wastewater reduction, and compliant discharge of salt-phenol wastewater. It employs EP and EPC engineering contracting models for water treatment solutions and has developed membrane separation, solvent extraction, bipolar membrane electrodialysis, and electro-adsorption technologies for lithium extraction from salt lakes. Production includes standardized and modular manufacturing lines for water treatment equipment and chemical agents.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are large-scale industrial and municipal enterprises, including major petrochemical, coal chemical, and coking companies, as well as industrial parks and salt lake resource developers. Notable clients include Sinopec, Zhongsha Petrochemical, Zhongtian Hechuang, China Coal Group, Shenhua Group, State Power Investment Corporation, ExxonMobil, BASF, and others. The company’s markets cover industrial wastewater treatment and resource recovery, salt lake lithium extraction, and seawater resource utilization.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in mainland China with business presence in Beijing, Tianjin, Henan, Inner Mongolia, Xinjiang, Tibet, Ningxia, Shanxi, Shaanxi, and other provinces. It has established subsidiaries and production bases in Zhengzhou, Wuhai, Tianjin, and other key regions. The company is expanding its footprint in western China and Tibet for salt lake lithium projects and has opportunities in Southeast Asia due to global industrial chain shifts.
categories.supply_chain_position: BGT Group operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the water treatment and resource recovery supply chain. It provides integrated engineering solutions, equipment manufacturing, and operational management services. The company also engages in upstream resource development through its salt lake and mineral resource extraction projects, establishing a vertical integration from resource extraction to wastewater treatment and product sales.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in high-salinity wastewater zero discharge, lithium extraction from salt lakes, heavy metal wastewater treatment, and salt-alkali land remediation. It invests heavily in membrane technology, solvent extraction, bipolar membrane electrodialysis, and electro-adsorption techniques. The strategic focus includes developing energy-efficient, environmentally friendly processes and expanding lithium resource recovery capabilities to lead the industry in technology and standards.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through engineering contracting (EPC and EP) for water treatment solutions, operation management and technical service fees based on water volume and contract terms, and direct sales of water treatment equipment, chemicals, and spare parts. The company also earns income from government subsidies and investment returns from financial products. Contracts are mainly secured via public bidding, competitive negotiation, and direct client engagements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: BGT Group is positioned as a leading domestic provider of industrial wastewater resource recovery and salt lake lithium extraction solutions. It holds a strong market position supported by proprietary technologies, extensive project experience, and a broad client base including top-tier industrial enterprises. The company has received multiple national and industry awards, reinforcing its status as a technology-driven leader in the ecological protection and environmental governance sector.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.04 billion, a 59.32% increase from 2023, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 133 million, up 28.12%. Total assets stood at RMB 2.36 billion with a slight decrease from the previous year, while net assets increased by 2.14% to RMB 1.48 billion. The company has shown steady growth in revenue and profitability, supported by expanding business scope and increased R&D investment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: BGT Group emphasizes its proprietary core technologies enabling cost-effective zero discharge and resource recovery from high-salinity industrial wastewater. Its integrated service model covers design, manufacturing, installation, operation, and maintenance, providing customized solutions that reduce environmental impact and operational costs. The company’s innovation in salt lake lithium extraction and comprehensive resource utilization differentiates it as a pioneer in sustainable industrial water treatment and mineral resource development.
